$comment: The bounded allow-list `fabrika guard portability-guard check` judges claude-plugins/fabrika/ and packages/fabrika-cli/src/ against. `exempt` is a permanent per-file cap for text that is not a portability defect. `unmigrated` is the sweep floor: one row per sweep unit, ceiling equal to that unit's reference count when the guard landed, each `why` naming the child that clears it. The floor only shrinks — a ceiling above the count reds as loudly as a count above the ceiling.

claude-plugins/fabrika/.claude-plugin/pl.why: The plugin manifest's `homepage`/`repository` name where this plugin is published; a published package has to say where it lives.

packages/fabrika-cli/src/guard/i18n-lite.why: This guard's scan root and config path are this repo's own directories, and they are behaviour rather than prose — moving them onto config is a separate ticket of its own class.

packages/fabrika-cli/src/guard/fanout.ts.why: The fanned-mutation manifest path is this repo's own directory, read as behaviour rather than written as prose — same class as the workflow literals, moved by its own ticket.

packages/fabrika-cli/src/guard/fanout-ve.why: `FEATURES_DIR`, the directory this guard walks. Behaviour rather than prose — same class as `fanout.ts`, moved by #7478, the scan-scope-literals ticket.

The fixture root mirroring `FEATURES_DIR` and two annotation assertions pinning the emitted path. Rewriting them would assert against a directory the verb never walks; they move with the literal under #7478.

packages/fabrika-cli/src/guard/design-to.why: `CSS_ROOTS`, the scan scope this guard walks. Behaviour rather than prose — same class as `i18n-literal-verb.ts`, moved by #7478, the scan-scope-literals ticket.
The fixture root mirroring `CSS_ROOTS`; the dual-root regression test is only a test while it names a root the verb actually scans, so it moves with the literal under #7478.

packages/fabrika-cli/src/guard/i18n-lite.why: `SCAN_ROOT`, the one value the exempt `i18n-literal-verb.ts` imports and walks. Behaviour rather than prose, now stated once instead of repeated through the report strings, and moved by #7478, the scan-scope-literals ticket.

packages/fabrika-cli/src/guard/leak.ts.why: `DOC_DIRS`, the doc-surface scope this gate classifies against. Behaviour rather than prose — a repo that keeps no decision corpus simply matches nothing; moved by #7478, the scan-scope-literals ticket.

packages/fabrika-cli/src/guard/leak.unit.why: Two assertions on the `DOC_DIRS` arm; dropping the literal drops the only coverage that arm has, so they move with it under #7478.

packages/fabrika-cli/src/config/keys/gov.why: The shipped default governed-root set is this repo's shape, kept as the value a repo overrides rather than as a sentence a reader follows.

packages/fabrika-cli/src/config/keys/doc.why: The key's own docblock names the repo whose docs the shipped default was drawn from, as the value's provenance rather than a pointer.

packages/fabrika-cli/src/build/scope-adm.why: The citation grammar `parseCitation` reads pins the `https://github.com/` host in its own regex, so a citation URL on any other host exercises nothing — these four are the inputs under test, not prose. The pin itself is the portability defect, parked behind #8359.

packages/fabrika-cli/src/build/claim-ver.why: The three `--cites` values a claim is admitted on, bound to the same hosted citation grammar `parseCitation` pins; every other fixture URL in the file is either a placeholder host or an API endpoint the matcher does not reach. The pin itself is the portability defect, parked behind #8359.

cli-lane.why: Three fixture paths in `packages/fabrika-cli/src/lane/prove-verb.unit.test.ts` that must start with the rendered-surface prefix `isUiSurface` reads; the prefix has since moved onto config, so these clear on the sweep that follows this unit onto that reader.

plugin-ship.why: Every remaining hit is a value rather than a sentence: 24 are the ship verbs' stderr lines quoted verbatim in the Errors tables and worked examples, each a literal of a string that lives in packages/fabrika-cli/src/ship and moves only when that string does, and 8 are the synthetic PR numbers and placeholder owner/repo the worked examples echo back. The prose around them carries no reference at all. The quoted half shrinks to zero when the CLI ship group's own strings are swept, and this floor shrinks with it — #8306, the CLI ship sweep, pays it down.

plugin-review.why: Verbatim pins of stderr lines the shipped `review` verbs print. The reference sits inside the quoted string, so it is a copy of behaviour that lives in packages/fabrika-cli/src/review/ — the source #8305 owns. It shrinks when that child rewrites the strings; changing the pin first would make the contract quote a line no verb prints.

plugin-review-ui.why: Same class as the `review` contract's row: verbatim pins of stderr lines the shipped `review-ui` verbs print, whose source strings live in packages/fabrika-cli/src/review-ui/ and move with #8305.

plugin-triage.why: The triage skill's text, cleared by #8295, the triage sweep child.

plugin-governance.why: The governance and front-door skills' text, cleared by #8296, the governance sweep child.

plugin-planning.why: The epic planning and plan-gate skills' text, cleared by #8297, the planning sweep child.

plugin-discovery.why: The grilling, wayfinding, graduate and prototyping skills' text, cleared by #8298, the discovery sweep child.

plugin-operate.why: The operate and heal-ci skills' text, cleared by #8299, the operate sweep child.

plugin-authoring.why: The build-ui, campaign, adr, glossary and taste-color skills' text, cleared by #8300, the authoring sweep child.

plugin-tail.why: Everything else the plugin ships — the guide, the README, the agents, the hook manifest and the remaining skills — cleared by #8301, the plugin tail sweep child.

cli-review.why: The two review groups' source. The sweep left 12 references, all behaviour rather than prose: the compiled-in `apps/web/src/` prefix inside `isUiSurface` plus the eleven fixtures that must match it to keep testing anything, and the shipped governance-root list a test asserts literally so the assertion is not vacuous.

cli-ship.why: The ship and heal-ci groups' source, cleared by #8306, the CLI ship sweep child.

cli-wire.why: The wire, io, ci and config groups' source, cleared by #8307, the wire sweep child.

cli-triage.why: The triage, report, graduate, grill and campaign groups' source, cleared by #8308, the CLI triage sweep child.

cli-capture.why: The capture, governance, recipe, status and hook groups' source, cleared by #8309, the capture sweep child.

cli-tail.why: The remaining small groups and the top-level modules under src/, cleared by #8310, the CLI tail sweep child.
